name: Per-face Column-based Face Culling with Opacity Masks
aliases: Per-face column-based face culling with opacity masks
definition: A face culling technique that uses per-face column arrays and opaque column arrays to determine visibility based on solid and transparent block transitions, allowing full per-face control over opacity.
summary: Per-face Column-based Face Culling with Opacity Masks determines visibility by distinguishing opaque and transparent surface contributions on partial shapes using per-face column arrays.
